notes.title: Testing system coming soon.
notes.content:
We decided to add a test yourself mode. For now this mode will let you choose a subject of quantum mechanics (for example: Bohr's model). Then you get 10 random questions about that subject. We are definitely thinking to also make tests for the other things included in QE. 

b] This will be included in the next Quantum Engine update, check that announcement for more info![/b]

notes.title: Big plans for 2017!
notes.content:
[h1] We're celebrating the launch of Quantum Engine with a huge update containing lots of new modes to help visualize chemistry for everyone, here's a brief overview of what's coming up very soon: [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Many simulations
    [*]Polarity explained
    [*]Tons of new animations including all five major chemical reactions
    [*]More facts & videos!
[/list]
[h1] A whole new look into Quantum Mechanics with lots of animations and simulations: [/h1]
[list]
       [*]Bohr's model of the atom
       [*]Young’s experiment and matter waves
       [*]Quantum superposition
       [*]Schrödinger’s cat
       [*]Nuclear fusion
       [*]Entanglement
[/list]
